+"""Freeze only after original dependent receipt is independently verified and committed."""

+import json,hashlib,sys
+H=Path(__file__).resolve().parent
+def main():
+ assert len(sys.argv)==5,'PREPARE.py <verified-receipt-local> <receipt-commit> <receipt-repo-path> <receipt-blob>'
+ receipt,commit,path,binding=sys.argv[1:];raw=Path(receipt).read_bytes();d=json.loads(raw)
+ assert hashlib.sha1(b'blob '+str(len(raw)).encode()+b'\0'+raw).hexdigest()==binding
+ assert d['state']=='ONE_TEST_DEPENDENT_CLIENT_ORIGINAL_VERIFIED_NOT_CARD_ADMISSION' and not d['gate_errors']
+ assert d['source']=='ce5145a2f3a361ad202ebc9cb86ef5b88a57dfc3' and d['run']==40977504099
+ assert d['gates']['ordinary']['rows']==19074 and d['gates']['ordinary']['skips']==43 and d['gates']['cards']['passed']==389 and d['gates']['client']['passed']==64
+ p=json.loads((H/'PROTOCOL.json').read_text());assert p['state']=='ISOLATED_DRAFT_DEPENDENT_RECEIPT_REQUIRED'
+ p.update(state='FROZEN_AFTER_VERIFIED_ONE_TEST_DEPENDENT_RECEIPT',base=commit,dependent_receipt=path,dependent_receipt_blob=binding)

+# Frozen remaining Fblthp card-gate supplement
+
+This research-only collector reuses the accepted Spellskite supplement infrastructure and all unchanged accepted runtime evidence. It does not alter frozen source ce5145a2 or launch a qualification. Run40977504099 is terminal and its original artifact was received once with c3fa0df9, verified without gate errors, and archived at57e1cff26e72503f7e6d45b07ae254d79aac91ee. PREPARE.py requires that committed exact receipt and blob before preparing a frozen successor. Review the resulting exact source/protocol/tests and one workflow-only child, reconcile ownership and all active workflows, then dispatch exactly once using the existing lock/concurrency contract.
+
+The collector compiles both tooling distributions before any card evidence command. It compares fresh canonical WAR50 metadata and every printing/ruling page with archived original metadata and the exact additive snapshot; verifies exact image HEAD; runs the unchanged printing check with a fresh transient cache; captures original Scryfall corpus bytes and Assay parse/explain/compile/full WAR differential output; captures the complete current mtgish IR bytes, exact Fblthp row and emitter draft. No emitted draft is installed. Source binding and module tree equality are required before and after all gates. The already received64client evidence is reused only with unchanged web-client tree.
+
+Archived metadata controls derive from original artifact12906973695, ZIP257050bytes SHA256591a339572ed073afa9056b27b1dda0ac1b2cb91fcec0a53037dbbf2e86ca5e8, already received at0aac4ec8. Reusing those bytes is not receiving that artifact again. Fresh HTTP data is still mandatory. WAR50 has no flavor_text field; the snapshot must omit flavorText rather than fabricate it.
+
+Original supplemental receiving must verify source/tree/validation/workflow/run/job/attempt, ZIPbytes/hash/manifest, protocol bytes, both source restoration phases, exact successful dependent receipt and unchanged module trees; independently rerun metadata checks against raw responses; verify corpus identity and current IR selection; inspect every Assay divergent row and every decline. A declined grammar is not a behavioral pass. Only after honest classification and all original proposal gates may a separate combined feature/card admission receipt be considered. No unrelated card/protected edits, multiplayer admission, official games/seeds or additional spending.

+"""Exact WAR50 source-metadata comparison; no normalization or admission decision."""
+import json,hashlib

+ result=[];i=0;seen=set()

+  assert url not in seen;seen.add(url)
+  http=json.loads(raw[f'metadata/{stem}-{i}.json.http.json']);assert http['status']==200 and http['url']==url
+  d=json.loads(raw[f'metadata/{stem}-{i}.json']);assert d['object']=='list' and isinstance(d['data'],list)
+  result+=d['data'];i+=1
+  if not d['has_more']:break
+  assert d.get('next_page') and i<20;url=d['next_page']
+ assert not any(n.startswith('metadata/'+stem+'-') and n.endswith('.json') and '.http.' not in n and int(n.rsplit('-',1)[1][:-5])>=i for n in raw)
+ return result,i
+def verify(raw,archived,snapshot):
+ c=json.loads(raw['metadata/war.json']);old=json.loads(archived)
+ assert c['name']=='Fblthp, the Lost' and c['set']=='war' and c['collector_number']=='50'
+ for k in FIELDS:assert (k in c)==(k in old) and c.get(k)==old.get(k),(k,c.get(k),old.get(k))
+ assert c['image_uris']['normal']==old['image_uris']['normal']
+ text=snapshot.decode();assert text.count('// Fblthp, the Lost\n')==1
+ g=json.loads(text.split('// Fblthp, the Lost\n')[1].split('\n// ')[0])
+ for a,b in [('name','name'),('manaCost','mana_cost'),('typeLine','type_line'),('oracleText','oracle_text')]:assert g[a]==c[b],a
+ assert g['creatureStats']=={'power':int(c['power']),'toughness':int(c['toughness'])}
+ assert c['colors']==c['color_identity']==['U'] and g['colorIdentityOverride']==['BLUE']
+ for a,b in [('collectorNumber','collector_number'),('artist','artist')]:assert g['metadata'][a]==c[b],a
+ if 'flavor_text' in c:assert g['metadata']['flavorText']==c['flavor_text']
+ else:assert 'flavorText' not in g['metadata']
+ assert g['metadata']['rarity']==c['rarity'].upper() and g['metadata']['imageUri']==c['image_uris']['normal']
+ rulings,nr=pages(raw,'rulings',c['rulings_uri']);assert [(x['published_at'],x['comment']) for x in rulings]==[(x['date'],x['text']) for x in g['metadata']['rulings']]
+ prints,np=pages(raw,'printings',c['prints_search_uri']);assert prints and len({p['id'] for p in prints})==len(prints)
+ assert json.loads(raw['metadata/printings-0.json'])['total_cards']==len(prints)

+ assert d['source']==P['dependent_source'] and d['run']==40977504099 and d['validation']=='2219d5783d67fd3b674cdd7850502cc1b1976668'
+ save(OUT/'DEPENDENT_RECEIPT.json',receipt)
+ if label=='initial':
+  for f in HERE.iterdir():
+   if f.is_file():save(OUT/'protocol'/f.name,f.read_bytes())

+  js(OUT/'BINDING.json',dict(source=os.environ['SOURCE'],tree=os.environ['SOURCE_TREE'],validation=git('rev-parse','HEAD'),validation_tree=git('rev-parse','HEAD^{tree}'),workflow=os.environ['WORKFLOW'],workflow_blob=git('hash-object',os.environ['WORKFLOW']),run=os.environ['GITHUB_RUN_ID'],attempt=int(os.environ['GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT']),run_number=int(os.environ['GITHUB_RUN_NUMBER'])))
+def stage(name,recipe,allowed=(0,)):
+ folder=OUT/name;folder.mkdir(parents=True)
+ with (folder/'stdout.log').open('wb') as out,(folder/'stderr.log').open('wb') as err:
+  rc=subprocess.run(['just','--working-directory',str(ROOT),'--justfile',str(HERE/'validation.just'),recipe],stdout=out,stderr=err).returncode
+ (folder/'exit.txt').write_text(str(rc)+'\n');assert rc in allowed,(name,rc)
+ if name=='compile-normal':
+  import re
+  log=(folder/'stdout.log').read_text()+(folder/'stderr.log').read_text();assert 'BUILD SUCCESSFUL' in log and not re.search(r'^e: |Compilation error|Unresolved reference|^> Task .* FAILED$',log,re.M)
+def get(url,name):

+  b=r.read();assert r.status==200;js(OUT/(name+'.http.json'),{'url':url,'status':r.status,'headers':dict(r.headers)})
+ save(OUT/name,b);return b
+def metadata():
+ c=json.loads(get(P['card_url'],'metadata/war.json'))
+ for stem,url in [('printings',c['prints_search_uri']),('rulings',c['rulings_uri'])]:

+  while url:
+   assert url not in seen;seen.add(url);d=json.loads(get(url,'metadata/'+stem+'-'+str(i)+'.json'));i+=1;assert i<20
+   if d['has_more']:assert d.get('next_page')

+  assert r.status==200;js(OUT/'metadata/image.json',{'url':c['image_uris']['normal'],'status':r.status,'headers':dict(r.headers)})
+ raw={str(f.relative_to(OUT)):f.read_bytes() for f in (OUT/'metadata').glob('*')}
+ js(OUT/'metadata/VERIFICATION.json',verify(raw,(HERE/'ARCHIVED_WAR_METADATA.json').read_bytes(),(ROOT/P['snapshot']).read_bytes()))
+def main():
+ OUT.mkdir();bind('initial');save(OUT/'check_metadata.json',subprocess.check_output(['python3',str(HERE/'check_metadata.py')]))
+ stage('compile-normal','compile');metadata()
+ cache=Path.home()/'.cache/scryfall/printings/fblthp-the-lost.json'
+ if cache.exists():cache.unlink()
+ stage('printing','printing');save(OUT/'metadata/printing-check-cache.json',cache.read_bytes())
+ stage('corpus','corpus');bulk=Path.home()/'.cache/scryfall/_bulk-oracle-cards.jsonl.gz';save(OUT/'corpus/oracle-cards.jsonl.gz',bulk.read_bytes())
+ for name in ['parse','explain','assay-compile','assay-war']:stage(name,name,(0,1) if name=='assay-compile' else (0,))
+ assert sha(bulk.read_bytes())==sha((OUT/'corpus/oracle-cards.jsonl.gz').read_bytes())
+ ir=get(P['mtgish_url'],'current-ir/mtgish.lines.json');save(ROOT/'mtgish-tooling/data/mtgish.lines.json',ir)
+ rows=[json.loads(line) for line in ir.decode().splitlines() if '"Name"' in line]
+ found=[r for r in rows if r.get('Name')=='Fblthp, the Lost'];assert len(found)==1;js(OUT/'current-ir/FBLTHP.json',found[0])
+ stage('current-ir','current-ir');assert (ROOT/'mtgish-tooling/data/mtgish.lines.json').read_bytes()==ir

+ try:main()
+ except Exception:OUT.mkdir(exist_ok=True);(OUT/'FAILURE.txt').write_text(traceback.format_exc());raise

+   OUT.mkdir(exist_ok=True);js(OUT/'MANIFEST.json',{str(f.relative_to(OUT)):sha(f.read_bytes()) for f in sorted(OUT.rglob('*')) if f.is_file() and f.name!='MANIFEST.json'})

+name: Manual Fblthp remaining card evidence R1
+on:
+  push:
+    branches: [validation/manual-fblthp-card-supplement-r1-20261030]
+    paths: ['.github/workflows/manual-fblthp-card-supplement-r1-20261030.yml']
+permissions: {contents: read}
+concurrency:
+  group: manual-transmission-engine-qualification
+  cancel-in-progress: false
+env:
+  SOURCE: b6b00c6d702125b8199594556e1a3f2c95c0c654
+  SOURCE_TREE: 4774b99dd03a581d836e9505032023779997da4b
+  WORKFLOW: .github/workflows/manual-fblthp-card-supplement-r1-20261030.yml
+  RECORD: experiments/manual-transmission/research/fblthp-card-supplement-draft-r1-20261030
+  GRADLE_OPTS: -Dorg.gradle.daemon=false
+  GRADLE_LOCK_SLOTS: '1'
+jobs:
+  verify:
+    if: github.run_number == 1 && github.run_attempt == 1
+    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
+    timeout-minutes: 120
+    steps:
+      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
+        with: {persist-credentials: false, fetch-depth: 0}
+      - uses: actions/setup-java@v4
+        with: {distribution: temurin, java-version: '21'}
+      - uses: gradle/actions/setup-gradle@v4
+      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
+        with: {node-version: '22', cache: npm, cache-dependency-path: web-client/package-lock.json}
+      - name: Install approved locked recipe runner
+        run: |
+          sudo apt-get update
+          sudo apt-get install -y just
+          command -v flock
+          mkdir -p "$HOME/.cache/argentum"
+      - name: Compile tooling then collect remaining card evidence
+        run: flock -x -w 1800 "$HOME/.cache/argentum/manual-transmission.lock" python3 "$RECORD/run.py"

+          include-hidden-files: true
+          if-no-files-found: error
+          retention-days: 90
